title: Help: Tales of Phantasia PSX Water type to RPG Maker MV

posts.author: mugen808
posts.body:
Hello,
I love the Tales Of Phantasia PS One graphics so much that i have imported them into RMMV and tried to replicate this beautiful game with the limitations of RM.
I would like to ask for ideas here about how to get those water effects into RMMV.
-The way the water truly moves from top left corner of the screen to bottom right one
-The gorgeous water undulation animation on character stepping on water
-the sprite reflection on the water
Here is a video to summarize my problematics:
In clear, as RM water tiles are too different, i replicated the Forest map using events for the water. This provides static animation but i am unable to get the diagonal movement effect with the water.
Water being made with events, i also seem to lose the possibility of water splash with foot steps and character reflection into water as, as far as i know, there are no plugins to display reflection or footsteps into events.
Events is not the only possible way to do this, i could also go with parallax, but i have been less successful with this method. I was able to get diagonal water movement on screen but ran into a few issues:
-The parallax doesn't fit well some tiles when it should be partially hidden/ not hidden
-The water animation itself becomes messy
-There is a part of the map with a water spring where the water movement is different (up to down). I don't know how to have two parallax with different direction and merging nicely.
If you can see how i could get closer to the original water setup in RMMV, any advice would be really welcome!

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
You have the main water parts and "deep water". This last one can be replaced with the southern stream.
But are you shore you want to use ripped assets? This means you can never share your game legally.

posts.author: mugen808
posts.body: Thanks for your attention. This is not a project meant for distribution, just an exercise to improve my RM skills. Skills I would need if i ever build a game i want to publish!^^

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body: Okay. Just thought it was worth mentioning.

posts.author: Artille
posts.body:
for the ripples in the water, you could detect whether or not the player is touching water when he moves, if he does, add ripples effect starting at player position, seem to be simple circles, so basing your radius on x,y player position should be a good start.
for the mirror effect, I saw a plugin recently that did just that, you might want to look for :
TSR Mirror
For the animation running from top left to bottom right, I'm not an expert, but I suppose you could use regionID to mark what tiles are "water", then apply a custom animation overlay on those tiles using something like
Galv’s Layer Graphics
